name: National Alliance on Mental Illness
description: Provides education, advocacy, and support for individuals and families affected by mental illness.

name: Mental Health America
description: Offers mental health screening tools, educational resources, prevention information, and community support.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: Provides free and confidential crisis support for people experiencing emotional distress or a mental health crisis in the United States.

name: World Health Organization
description: Provides global information, guidance, research, and resources related to mental health and psychological well-being.

name: Counselling Association of Nigeria
description: A professional counselling organization in Nigeria providing resources and professional support related to personal, social, educational, developmental, career, community, trauma, anxiety, and other counselling services.

name: American Psychological Association
description: Provides psychological science resources, research, professional information, educational materials, and resources covering many areas of human behavior and mental health.

name: APA PsycInfo
description: Provides access to authoritative research literature covering psychology, behavioral science, social science, education, neuroscience, and related disciplines.

name: Society for Industrial and Organizational Psychology
description: Provides research, professional resources, and practical knowledge about human behavior, performance, well-being, leadership, assessment, and organizational effectiveness in workplace settings.

name: International Association of Applied Psychology
description: Promotes the science and practice of applied psychology and supports communication and collaboration among applied psychologists worldwide.

name: International Labour Organization
description: Provides resources and guidance on workplace mental health, psychosocial risks, occupational safety, employee well-being, healthy working environments, and decent work.

name: American Counseling Association
description: Provides professional resources, education, ethical guidance, and information supporting counselling practice and human development.

name: British Psychological Society
description: Provides psychological knowledge, professional resources, research, and educational information to support the understanding and application of psychology.

name: Mental Health Foundation
description: Provides information, education, and resources focused on protecting and improving mental health and preventing mental health problems.

name: Mind
description: Provides information and support resources related to mental health, emotional well-being, coping strategies, and accessing appropriate help.

name: UNICEF
description: Provides resources addressing child and adolescent development, mental health, emotional well-being, education, protection, and social development.

name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
description: Provides public health information and resources concerning mental health, emotional well-being, behavioral health, prevention, and community health.

name: National Institute of Mental Health
description: Provides research-based information about mental health conditions, treatment, prevention, and the science of mental health.

name: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration
description: Provides resources related to mental health, substance use, prevention, treatment, recovery, and behavioral health services.

name: International Labour Organization Workplace Well-being
description: Provides guidance and practical resources for improving workplace health, employee well-being, psychosocial safety, and healthy working environments.

name: Society for Human Resource Management
description: Provides professional resources related to human resources, workplace culture, employee development, leadership, organizational practices, and workforce management.
